replicaCount.title: Replica Count
replicaCount.description: Number of application replicas. PhotoPrism keeps state on its volumes, so values above 1 require storage that supports the configured access modes.

repository.title: Repository
repository.description: Container image repository to pull the application from.

tag.title: Image Tag
tag.description: Override the container tag; leave empty to use the chart appVersion.

pullPolicy.title: Pull Policy
pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy passed to Kubernetes.

command.title: Command
command.description: Overrides the container entrypoint. Leave empty to use the image default.

args.title: Args
args.description: Overrides the container arguments. Leave empty to use the image default.

allowPrivilegeEscalation.title: Allow Privilege Escalation
allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Whether a process may gain more privileges than its parent.

runAsNonRoot.title: Run As Non Root
runAsNonRoot.description: Requires the container to run as a non-root user.

drop.title: Drop
drop.description: Linux capabilities removed from the container.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Linux capabilities added to or removed from the container.

type.title: Type
type.description: Seccomp profile applied to the container.

seccompProfile.title: Seccomp Profile
seccompProfile.description: Seccomp profile applied to the container.

runAsUser.title: Run As User
runAsUser.description: UID the container process runs as.

runAsGroup.title: Run As Group
runAsGroup.description: GID the container process runs as.

securityContext.title: Security Context
securityContext.description: Security settings applied to the application container.

fsGroup.title: Fs Group
fsGroup.description: Supplemental group applied to mounted volumes, so the container can write to them.

fsGroupChangePolicy.title: Fs Group Change Policy
fsGroupChangePolicy.description: When Kubernetes reapplies fsGroup ownership to volume contents.

podSecurityContext.title: Pod Security Context
podSecurityContext.description: Security settings applied to the pod as a whole.

nameOverride.title: Name Override
nameOverride.description: Replaces the chart name used to build resource names.

fullnameOverride.title: Fullname Override
fullnameOverride.description: Replaces the full release name used for resource names.

adminPassword.title: Admin Password
adminPassword.description: Leave empty to auto-generate and store the password in a secret.

enabled.title: Enable Portal Integration
enabled.description: Set to true when a PhotoPrism Portal is available.

secretName.title: Secret Name
secretName.description: Existing secret holding the cluster join credentials. Leave empty to have the chart create one.

portalURL.title: Portal URL
portalURL.description: Base URL of the cluster management portal.

uuid.title: UUID
uuid.description: Cluster UUID (v4) to scope node credentials.

cidr.title: CIDR
cidr.description: Cluster CIDR for IP-based authorization, e.g. 10.0.0.0/8.

trustedProxy.title: Trusted Proxy
trustedProxy.description: CIDR ranges or IPv4/v6 addresses from which reverse proxy headers can be trusted, separated by commas.

joinToken.title: Join Token
joinToken.description: Secret TOKEN required to join a cluster; min 24 chars.

jwtScope.title: JWT Scope
jwtScope.description: Allowed JWT SCOPES (space separated). Leave empty to accept defaults.

integration.title: Integration
integration.description: Connection details used to register with a Portal.

cluster.title: Cluster
cluster.description: Settings for running this instance as part of a PhotoPrism cluster.

storageClassName.title: Storage Class Name
storageClassName.description: StorageClass used for the volume claims. Leave empty to use the cluster default.

enabled.title: Enable Originals PVC
enabled.description: Provision a PVC for originals; disable when mounting NFS manually.

size.title: Size
size.description: Requested capacity of the originals volume.

accessModes.title: Access Modes
accessModes.description: Access modes requested for the originals volume.

mountPath.title: Mount Path
mountPath.description: Path the originals volume is mounted at inside the container.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Mounts the originals from an NFS export instead of a volume claim.

server.title: Server
server.description: NFS server hostname or address. Required when NFS mode is enabled.

path.title: Path
path.description: Exported NFS path to mount. Required when NFS mode is enabled.

nfs.title: NFS
nfs.description: Mounts the originals from an NFS export instead of a volume claim.

originals.title: Originals
originals.description: Volume holding the imported media files.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Creates a volume for the storage folder holding the cache, sidecar files and database.

size.title: Storage Volume Size
size.description: PVC size for /photoprism/storage (can be expanded later).

accessModes.title: Access Modes
accessModes.description: Access modes requested for the storage volume.

mountPath.title: Mount Path
mountPath.description: Path the storage volume is mounted at inside the container.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Volume holding the cache, sidecar files and database.

persistence.title: Persistence
persistence.description: Volumes for the originals and storage folders.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Creates a Service for the application.

service.title: Service
service.description: Service exposing the application inside the cluster.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Creates an Ingress resource for the application.

className.title: Class Name
className.description: IngressClass that should handle the Ingress.

annotations.title: Annotations
annotations.description: Annotations added to the Ingress, for controller-specific settings.

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.description: Host rules to route to the application.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: TLS configuration referencing the secrets that hold the certificates.

ingress.title: Ingress
ingress.description: Ingress exposing the application outside the cluster.

cpu.title: CPU
cpu.description: Maximum CPU the container may use.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Maximum memory the container may use.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Upper CPU and memory bound for the container.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Minimum CPU and memory reserved for the container.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: CPU and memory requests and limits for the container.

nodeSelector.title: Node Selector
nodeSelector.description: Node labels the pod must match to be scheduled.

tolerations.title: Tolerations
tolerations.description: Taints the pod tolerates when scheduling.

affinity.title: Affinity
affinity.description: Affinity and anti-affinity rules applied to the pod.

PHOTOPRISM_DISABLE_OIDC.title: Disable OpenID Connect
PHOTOPRISM_DISABLE_OIDC.description: Set to false to enable OpenID Connect login with the settings below.

PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_URI.title: OIDC URI
PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_URI.description: Issuer URI for single sign-on via OpenID Connect, e.g. https://accounts.google.com.

PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_CLIENT.title: OIDC Client
PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_CLIENT.description: Client ID for single sign-on via OpenID Connect.

PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_SECRET.title: OIDC Secret
PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_SECRET.description: Client SECRET for single sign-on via OpenID Connect.

PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_SCOPES.title: OIDC Scopes
PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_SCOPES.description: Client authorization SCOPES for single sign-on via OpenID Connect.

PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_PROMPT.title: OIDC Prompt
PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_PROMPT.description: Authorization PROMPT for single sign-on via OpenID Connect (login, select_account, consent).

PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_REGISTER.title: OIDC Register
PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_REGISTER.description: Allows new users to create an account when they sign in with OpenID Connect.

PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_REDIRECT.title: OIDC Redirect
PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_REDIRECT.description: Automatically redirects unauthenticated users to the configured identity provider.

PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_USERNAME.title: OIDC Username
PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_USERNAME.description: Preferred username CLAIM for new OpenID Connect users (preferred_username, name, nickname, email).

PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_PROVIDER.title: OIDC Provider
PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_PROVIDER.description: Custom identity provider NAME, e.g. Google.

PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_WEBDAV.title: OIDC Webdav
PHOTOPRISM_OIDC_WEBDAV.description: Allows new OpenID Connect users to use WebDAV when they have a role that allows it.

oidc.title: OIDC
oidc.description: OpenID Connect settings. Each key is passed to the container as that environment variable.

PHOTOPRISM_SITE_URL.title: Site URL
PHOTOPRISM_SITE_URL.description: Canonical site URL used in generated links and to determine HTTPS/TLS (scheme://host[:port]).

PHOTOPRISM_SITE_NAME.title: Site Name
PHOTOPRISM_SITE_NAME.description: Optional short name identifying this instance in cluster switchers and selectors. Example: Acme Media.

PHOTOPRISM_SITE_TITLE.title: Site Title
PHOTOPRISM_SITE_TITLE.description: Displayed title in the PhotoPrism UI. Example: Photo Library.

PHOTOPRISM_SITE_CAPTION.title: Site Caption
PHOTOPRISM_SITE_CAPTION.description: Optional tagline shown beneath the title. Example: Explore Your Media.

PHOTOPRISM_SITE_DESCRIPTION.title: Site Description
PHOTOPRISM_SITE_DESCRIPTION.description: Short description used in metadata and link previews. Example: Private family archive.

PHOTOPRISM_SITE_AUTHOR.title: Site Author
PHOTOPRISM_SITE_AUTHOR.description: Owner or copyright notice displayed in metadata. Example: © 2025 The Smith Family.

PHOTOPRISM_SITE_FAVICON.title: Site Favicon
PHOTOPRISM_SITE_FAVICON.description: Filename or URL of the favicon asset. Example: /photoprism/assets/favicon.ico.

PHOTOPRISM_SITE_PREVIEW.title: Sharing Preview URL
PHOTOPRISM_SITE_PREVIEW.description: Image URL used for social previews. Example: https://example.com/preview.jpg.

PHOTOPRISM_APP_NAME.title: App Name
PHOTOPRISM_APP_NAME.description: Display name when PhotoPrism is installed as a PWA.

PHOTOPRISM_APP_ICON.title: App Icon
PHOTOPRISM_APP_ICON.description: Icon style for the PWA shortcut (logo, app, mint, square, etc.). Example: logo.

PHOTOPRISM_APP_COLOR.title: App Color
PHOTOPRISM_APP_COLOR.description: Hex color used for the PWA splash screen and tint. Example: #19191a.

PHOTOPRISM_DEFAULT_THEME.title: Default Theme
PHOTOPRISM_DEFAULT_THEME.description: Theme name applied to new users (leave blank for PhotoPrism default).

PHOTOPRISM_DEFAULT_LOCALE.title: Default Locale
PHOTOPRISM_DEFAULT_LOCALE.description: Language code assigned to new users. Example: en or de.

PHOTOPRISM_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE.title: Default Timezone
PHOTOPRISM_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE.description: Timezone name used for scheduling (e.g. Europe/Berlin).

PHOTOPRISM_PLACES_LOCALE.title: Places Locale
PHOTOPRISM_PLACES_LOCALE.description: Language code for location details (en, de, local, etc.).

PHOTOPRISM_PASSWORD_LENGTH.title: Minimum Password Length
PHOTOPRISM_PASSWORD_LENGTH.description: Enforce a minimum password length for local users.

PHOTOPRISM_SESSION_MAXAGE.title: Session Max Age (Seconds)
PHOTOPRISM_SESSION_MAXAGE.description: Maximum session lifetime; doubled when 2FA is enabled.

PHOTOPRISM_SESSION_TIMEOUT.title: Session Idle Timeout (Seconds)
PHOTOPRISM_SESSION_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum idle time before users are signed out.

PHOTOPRISM_SESSION_CACHE.title: Session Cache TTL (Seconds)
PHOTOPRISM_SESSION_CACHE.description: Duration session data is cached in memory (60-3600).

PHOTOPRISM_LOGIN_INFO.title: Login Footer Text
PHOTOPRISM_LOGIN_INFO.description: Optional message displayed below the login form.

PHOTOPRISM_HTTP_COMPRESSION.title: HTTP Compression
PHOTOPRISM_HTTP_COMPRESSION.description: Web server compression METHODS as a comma-separated preference list (e.g. "zstd,gzip"; supported: gzip, zstd, none).

PHOTOPRISM_CDN_URL.title: CDN URL
PHOTOPRISM_CDN_URL.description: Base URL for serving static assets via CDN. Example: https://cdn.example.com.

PHOTOPRISM_CDN_VIDEO.title: CDN Video URL
PHOTOPRISM_CDN_VIDEO.description: Optional CDN endpoint for streaming videos. Example: https://videos.example.com.

PHOTOPRISM_CORS_ORIGIN.title: CORS Allowed Origin
PHOTOPRISM_CORS_ORIGIN.description: Origin allowed to issue cross-origin requests. Example: https://app.example.com.

PHOTOPRISM_CORS_HEADERS.default: Accept, Accept-Ranges, Content-Disposition, Content-Encoding, Content-Range, Location
PHOTOPRISM_CORS_HEADERS.title: CORS Headers
PHOTOPRISM_CORS_HEADERS.description: Comma-separated headers exposed for cross-origin requests.

PHOTOPRISM_CORS_METHODS.title: CORS Methods
PHOTOPRISM_CORS_METHODS.description: Allowed HTTP methods for cross-origin requests.

PHOTOPRISM_LEGAL_INFO.title: Legal Notice Text
PHOTOPRISM_LEGAL_INFO.description: Text displayed in the footer for legal notices.

PHOTOPRISM_BACKUP_SCHEDULE.title: Backup Schedule
PHOTOPRISM_BACKUP_SCHEDULE.description: Cron schedule or keyword (daily/weekly) controlling automated backups. Example: 0 3 * * *.

PHOTOPRISM_BACKUP_RETAIN.title: Backups to Keep
PHOTOPRISM_BACKUP_RETAIN.description: Number of backup archives to retain (-1 keeps all). Example: 3.

PHOTOPRISM_BACKUP_ALBUMS.title: Backup Albums
PHOTOPRISM_BACKUP_ALBUMS.description: Include YAML album metadata in backups.

PHOTOPRISM_BACKUP_PATH.title: Backup Path
PHOTOPRISM_BACKUP_PATH.description: Custom base directory for backups. Example: /photoprism/backups.

PHOTOPRISM_FILES_QUOTA.title: Total File Quota (GB)
PHOTOPRISM_FILES_QUOTA.description: Limit the total size of indexed originals (0 for unlimited).

PHOTOPRISM_UPLOAD_ALLOW.title: Allowed Upload Types
PHOTOPRISM_UPLOAD_ALLOW.description: Comma-separated list of permitted upload extensions.

PHOTOPRISM_IMPORT_ALLOW.title: Allowed Import Types
PHOTOPRISM_IMPORT_ALLOW.description: Comma-separated list of permitted import extensions.

PHOTOPRISM_UPLOAD_ARCHIVES.title: Upload Archives
PHOTOPRISM_UPLOAD_ARCHIVES.description: Allows upload of zip archives (will be extracted before import).

PHOTOPRISM_UPLOAD_NSFW.title: Upload NSFW
PHOTOPRISM_UPLOAD_NSFW.description: Allows uploads that might be offensive (when disabled, files flagged by the NSFW model are rejected before indexing).

PHOTOPRISM_DISABLE_TLS.title: Disable TLS
PHOTOPRISM_DISABLE_TLS.description: Disables HTTPS/TLS even if the site URL starts with https:// and a certificate is available.

PHOTOPRISM_DISABLE_MCP.title: Disable Mcp
PHOTOPRISM_DISABLE_MCP.description: Disables the Model Context Protocol (MCP) API endpoint for AI agent integrations.

PHOTOPRISM_WALLPAPER_URI.title: Wallpaper URI
PHOTOPRISM_WALLPAPER_URI.description: Background image URL for the login screen.

config.title: Config
config.description: Application configuration. Each key is passed to the container as that environment variable.

driver.title: Driver
driver.description: Set to mysql when connecting to MariaDB/MySQL.

server.title: Server
server.description: Host:port or socket path for the database server.

password.title: Database Password
password.description: Optional password stored in the chart-managed secret. Ignored when an external secret is referenced.

passwordSecretName.title: Password Secret Name
passwordSecretName.description: Reference an existing Kubernetes Secret for the password instead of the chart-managed secret.

passwordSecretKey.title: Password Secret Key
passwordSecretKey.description: Key within the referenced secret (defaults to PHOTOPRISM_DATABASE_PASSWORD).

timeout.title: Connection Timeout (Seconds)
timeout.description: Timeout when establishing a database connection.

conns.title: Max Open Connections
conns.description: Maximum number of open connections (0 lets PhotoPrism decide).

connsIdle.title: Max Idle Connections
connsIdle.description: Maximum number of idle connections (0 lets PhotoPrism decide).
